questions.question: Why should loose roofing debris be removed from walkways?
options: To reduce trip and slip hazards
questions.explanation:
Loose debris can cause workers to slip or trip.
Keeping walkways clear improves jobsite safety.
Good housekeeping is important on roofing projects.

questions.category: A2 — Use Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) and Safety Equipment
questions.question: Why should fall protection equipment be inspected before use?
options: Damaged equipment may not protect during a fall
questions.explanation:
Harnesses, lanyards, and connectors must be in good condition.
Cuts, wear, or damage can cause failure.
Inspection helps prevent serious injury.

questions.question: Why should a roofing knife have a sharp blade?
options: Sharp blades cut more safely and cleanly
Dull blades always reduce injury risk
questions.explanation:
Dull blades require more force and can slip.
Sharp blades improve control and cutting quality.
Blades should be handled safely.

questions.category: B2 — Use Power Tools, Pneumatic Tools, Hot-Air Welding, Induction, and Fuelled Equipment
questions.question: Why should power tool guards be kept in place?
options: Guards protect workers from moving parts and debris
Guards should be removed for accuracy
questions.explanation:
Guards reduce exposure to blades, wheels, and moving parts.
Removing guards increases injury risk.
Tools should be used as designed.

questions.category: B3 — Use Hoisting, Lifting, and Rigging Equipment
questions.question: Why should a load be balanced before lifting roofing materials?
options: Unbalanced loads can shift or fall
questions.explanation:
Loads can move during lifting.
A balanced load is easier to control.
This reduces risk to workers and property.
